48.original: Hello, hello! Welcome to Tamamizu, friend. A <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> from the surface, though you may be, I sense you enjoy swimming a great deal. You would get along quite well with my striped ray here.

49.original: More than anything, she loves to wade through the waters and eat the small fish as she goes.

50.original: She would be over the moon if you would take her for a quick swim around the village.

51.original: Did she buck you off or did you fall, friend? Hahaha! Either way, if you are willing to give it another try, I am sure she is, too!

52.original: Welcome back! I trust you enjoyed the ride? By the swishing of her tail, I can tell my striped ray certainly did! Or, perhaps, she simply ate something that did not sit right with her.

53.original: Hahaha! She devours everything that crosses her path, especially things that glisten. Once she swallowed an entire coffer's worth of gold coins we found on a sunken ship!

54.original: In any case, I thank you for taking her out. Do be sure to come back to visit sometime. She has taken quite a shine to you!
